title: Dream of Sadat's assassination as it happened

tellings.quote: specific in my case cuz my first dream, which I chronicle in the book, was Sadat's assassination September 6, 1981, where I was in I was there.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says the first of his unusual dreams showed him the assassination of Egypt's president Anwar Sadat in 1981 while it was happening. He was based at Fort Bliss, Texas, at the time, but he tells Michels that in the dream "I was there," and he dates it "September 6, 1981." He writes about it in his book A State of Mind: Faith and the CIA, and if it is true, it would mean a dream showed him a real event on the other side of the world as it took place.
